label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss) is TP because the resolved sink value at L61-L62 is attacker-controlled data from user input, despite the presence of encodeForHTML(...). The XSS occurs because the encoded SQL string is still concatenated into HTML output. Alert 2 (java/sql-injection) is also TP because the resolved sink value at L56 is directly constructed from user input without sanitization.

evidence.note: SQL query constructed using user-provided value 'bar' directly, making it vulnerable to SQL injection.
User-provided data flows into HTML output via concatenation, despite encodeForHTML being applied to the SQL string, making it vulnerable to XSS.
